subject: IR notification: transient auth alert, IRP handover and evidence plan
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@fincloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: IR notification: transient auth alert, IRP handover and evidence plan

Alice —

Quick heads-up: between 08:43–08:51 PDT we observed a transient spike of ~0.8% 401/unauth responses from the token service for requests routed from the us-west-2 region. We immediately rolled a fix to the token cache layer at 08:52; 401 rates returned to baseline by 08:53. No long-lived credentials were exposed and we have not seen any anomalous data access tied to the window.

Action items we are proposing now:
- I wanted to notify FinCloud security as a courtesy and kick off an evidence handoff so you can validate on your side.
- We will share: a one-page IRP summary, a sampled set of S3 access logs for the time window (redacted), our SOC 2 evidence index with relevant controls called out, and a SIG/CAIQ mapping showing control coverage.
- We are requesting a short retention exception to hold the sampled logs for an additional 30 days beyond our default window while FinCloud completes review. If that’s acceptable please confirm who signs off on retention on your side.

Attachments: redwood_irp_summary.pdf (IR timeline & mitigations), s3-access-logs-sample.csv (redacted), soc2-evidence-index.xlsx, sig-caiq-mapping.xlsx
Drive link for large files: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-evidence (view-only link; will enable access to security@fincloud.com once you confirm transfer method)

If you’d like a short call to walk through the artifacts I can be available this afternoon.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_irp_summary.pdf)

From: Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@fincloud.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fincloud.com
Date: 2026-08-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: IR notification: transient auth alert, IRP handover and evidence plan

Evelyn —

Thanks for the prompt notification and the clear summary. Appreciate the proactivity. A few asks from our side:
1) Please include a concise chronology (timestamps in UTC) for the 08:43–08:53 window and the exact token/service endpoints affected.
2) We need the SOC 2 mapping to call out which CC controls the sampled logs map to (particularly CC6/CC7 related items).
3) For evidence transfer, FinCloud prefers encrypted transfer to our secure mailbox (security-evidence@fincloud.com) or a pre-authorized SFTP endpoint. Can you confirm which you’ll use?
4) Retention exception: we can approve a 30-day holding period if you provide a documented redaction plan (PII removal) and a legal point-of-contact for the sign-off.

Assuming you can provide the chronology and the mapping, we’ll triage and get back on sign-off for retention within 24 hours. If you’re offering a walkthrough it may help speed validation — value a 20–30 minute session.

— Alice Rivera
Head of Security, FinCloud Systems
security@fincloud.com
(Please include security-evidence@fincloud.com as the transfer target)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@fincloud.com>, security-evidence@fincloud.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: IR notification: transient auth alert, IRP handover and evidence plan

On Mon, Aug 1, 2026 at 10:03 AM Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@fincloud.com> wrote:
> Evelyn —
>
> Thanks for the prompt notification and the clear summary. Appreciate the proactivity. A few asks from our side: ...

Hi Alice —

Thanks — timeline below in UTC and answers inline.
Timeline (UTC):
- 2026-08-01T15:43:12Z: Token service began returning elevated 401s for a subset of cached tokens (us-west-2 edge cluster).
- 2026-08-01T15:49:00Z: Engineering identified a cache serialization bug introduced in a deployment step; immediate rollback scheduled.
- 2026-08-01T15:52:40Z: Rollback completed; token responses returned to baseline by 15:53:10Z.
- 2026-08-01T16:10:00Z: Post-rollback validation and additional monitoring rules added.

What we’re sharing now:
- redwood_irp_summary.pdf: 1-page timeline, root cause hypothesis, mitigations applied, action owners.
- s3-access-logs-sample.csv: redacted sample of S3 GET/PUT events for the 15:42–15:55 UTC window (IP hashes and object keys partially masked).
- soc2-evidence-index.xlsx: index of evidence artifacts tied to SOC 2 CCs; we’ve highlighted CC6 & CC7 rows.
- sig-caiq-mapping.xlsx: CAIQ/SIG control matrix with the specific controls called out for the token service path.

Transfer method: we will upload the files to the Drive folder listed earlier and enable access for security-evidence@fincloud.com once you confirm. If you prefer SFTP we can arrange that as well — indicate which host and account and we’ll push via secure channels.

Redaction plan: internal process applied to sampled logs to remove full object keys and IP addresses; hashes used to preserve telemetry fidelity. Legal contact for sign-off: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai, cc’d).

Proposed retention exception: +30 days from the day evidence is accepted by FinCloud; we will auto-delete samples at that time and provide a deletion confirmation. If that works, please confirm and we’ll enable sharing and book a 20-minute walkthrough for tomorrow.

Links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-evidence
- Internal ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SIG-3142 (contains raw timeline and engineer notes; access available on request)

Proposed time for walkthrough: 2026-08-02T17:00:00Z (30 minutes). Confirm availability and preferred transfer method.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(attachments: soc2-evidence-index.xlsx, sig-caiq-mapping.xlsx, s3-access-logs-sample.csv)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Subject: FW: IR notification: transient auth alert, IRP handover and evidence plan — retention exception request

Marissa / Karthik —

FYI: FinCloud wants a documented retention exception and redaction plan before they sign off for us to hold sampled logs an extra 30 days. I attached the redaction notes and the sampled CSV (redwood_irp_summary.pdf and s3-access-logs-sample.csv).

Can you:
- Marissa: please open a retention-exception request with Legal and include the redaction plan (point them to the Drive link and SIG-3142). Ask Legal to approve conditioned on deletion confirmation after 30 days.
- Karthik: hold on final upload to SFTP until Legal confirms the exception. If Legal prefers, we can instead limit sharing to the encrypted Drive link and provide an audit trail of access.

I’ll wait for Legal approval before enabling security-evidence@fincloud.com access.

Thanks — short timeline: FinCloud expects confirmation within 24 hours.

Evelyn
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
